sentences.en: When I was in elementary school, I read this book.
sentences.zh: 我上小学的时候读过这本书。

sentences.en: In Japan, attendance at elementary and junior high school is compulsory.
sentences.zh: 在日本，小学和初中上学是强制性的。

sentences.en: We used to play musical chairs in elementary school.
sentences.zh: 我们过去常在小学玩抢椅子的游戏。

senses.zh: 简单的，基本的；基础的，初级的；小学的；单一元素的，非化合物的
